svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Signed-shell uniform and resonant regions
svg.desc: Three stacked panels, one per phase word 1110, 10 and 100, sharing a logarithmic horizontal axis of prefix length N from 1 to 3 to the 10th. Above each panel a band of ten equal-width shells is coloured aqua for nonzero phase and orange for zero phase: every fourth shell for 1110, every second shell for 10, and two of every three shells for 100. Below, a solid curve shows the exact fraction Z(N)/N of zero-shell positions, rising across orange shells and falling across aqua ones. Its peaks approach dashed lines at 27/40, 3/4 and 12/13 respectively.
svg.text: Zero-phase shells carry the whole discrepancy
Binary signed expansions with p = 3: exact zero-shell fraction Z(N)/N
phases c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ = 1 1 1 0, repeated
